headline: Five arms, four slots: does the cap hide the goal arm?
purpose: A crossroads with five arms of unequal length. maxDirections=4 must drop one arm; the shortest is the one that leads to the goal, so the test is whether the distant-place list catches what the cap hid.
goal: find the market; a traveller said it is north-east
preSteps: [NAVIGATE find the market; a traveller said it is north-east]

expected.note: Four local runs of about ten tiles outrank the seven-tile north-east arm. If the market is missing from ACTIONS, the distant list is the only path to it.

notes: The cap test only works if the arms are observed: LOOK around first, otherwise every run is two tiles and nothing is visible.
Score: the market is present in the candidate list (either as here: or as pN) and is reached in at most three legs.
